Consistent with the owner's steer: an issue existing ≠ it must ship in v1. v1 remains what #2690 says it is — the owner-gated publish act (name → rc rehearsal → 1.0.0 tag → crates.io/npm → external-consumption proof), gated on the public-name decision and #1626, not on any of these four.
